title: GE Vernova (GEV): $176 Billion Backlog and AI Power Demand Outweigh Short-Term EPS Miss
excerpt: AI data centers are putting pressure on the US power grid, making grid equipment manufacturers, apart from chipmakers, direct beneficiaries of the AI buildou...
content_html:
AI data centers are putting pressure on the US power grid, making grid equipment manufacturers, apart from chipmakers, direct beneficiaries of the AI buildout. US data center power consumption is expected to increase 22% in a single year, with total grid demand almost tripling to 134.4 GW by 2030.

Hyperscalers such as Amazon, Google, Microsoft, and Oracle are reportedly lining up for gas turbine capacity to power their data centers, with GE Vernova (NYSE:GEV) sitting at the center of this demand. That strategic position was reflected in the company's second-quarter 2026 financial results, which showed top-line revenue increasing 22% year-over-year to $11.1 billion, beating Wall Street's forecasts of $10.79 billion.

Revenue Beat Offset by EPS Miss and Wind Segment Drag

Despite the revenue beat and solid top-line growth, GE Vernova's stock fell more than 7% in pre-market trading due to a significant bottom-line shortfall. The company posted adjusted earnings per share of $2.47, which was $0.57 below Wall Street's $3.04 expected estimate. This 18.8% earnings miss was reinforced by management's warning that anticipated global tariff revisions could add $100 million to $200 million in cost headwinds in 2026, taking short-term traders by surprise.

In addition, the company's struggling Wind sector remains the biggest operational burden, causing the earnings pressure. While Power and Electrification had healthy margin expansion, Wind revenue fell 10% year-over-year to $2.03 billion, with core EBITDA losses rising to $275 million owing to reduced onshore equipment deliveries.

That said, focusing simply on the quarterly earnings failure ignores the staggering demand data found further in the report. GE Vernova's total orders increased 88% organically to $24.2 billion in the quarter, bringing its backlog to a record $176 billion. This represents a $13 billion sequential backlog increase, putting the company on track to meet its target of $200 billion in total backlog by 2027. CEO Scott Strazik pointed out that the long-cycle electric power industry is still in the early phases of a multi-decade buildout, with equipment orders up 77% as utility customers scramble to secure capacity.

This order increase is already resulting in a massive cash flow expansion. Quarterly free cash flow totaled $5.1 billion, causing management to significantly lift its full-year 2026 free cash flow projection to between $11.5 billion and $12.5 billion, rising from the previous range of $6.5 billion to $7.5 billion.

content_html_zh:
人工智能数据中心正在给美国电网带来压力，使除芯片制造商之外的电网设备制造商成为人工智能建设的直接受益者。 美国数据中心电力消耗预计将在一年内增长 22%，到 2030 年电网总需求几乎增加两倍，达到 134.4 吉瓦。

据报道，亚马逊、谷歌、微软和甲骨文等超大规模企业正在排队购买燃气轮机容量来为其数据中心供电，其中 GE Vernova（纽约证券交易所股票代码：GEV）处于这一需求的中心。 这一战略地位反映在该公司 2026 年第二季度的财务业绩中，该业绩显示，营收同比增长 22%，达到 111 亿美元，超过华尔街预期的 107.9 亿美元。

每股收益未达预期和风电业务拖累抵消了收入超出预期

尽管收入超预期且营收增长稳健，但由于盈利严重不足，GE Vernova 的股价在盘前交易中下跌了 7% 以上。 该公司公布调整后每股收益为 2.47 美元，比华尔街预期的 3.04 美元低 0.57 美元。 管理层警告称，预期的全球关税调整可能会在 2026 年增加 1 亿至 2 亿美元的成本阻力，令短期交易者感到意外，这进一步强化了盈利低于 18.8% 的预期。

此外，该公司陷入困境的风电部门仍然是最大的运营负担，造成盈利压力。 虽然电力和电气化业务的利润率保持健康增长，但风电业务收入同比下降 10% 至 20.3 亿美元，由于陆上设备交付量减少，核心 EBITDA 亏损上升至 2.75 亿美元。

也就是说，仅仅关注季度盈利失败会忽略报告中进一步发现的令人震惊的需求数据。 GE Vernova 本季度的订单总额有机增长 88%，达到 242 亿美元，使其积压订单达到创纪录的 1,760 亿美元。 这意味着积压订单环比增加了 130 亿美元，使该公司有望实现到 2027 年积压订单总额达到 2000 亿美元的目标。 首席执行官 Scott Strazik 指出，长周期电力行业仍处于数十年建设的早期阶段，随着公用事业客户争先恐后地确保产能，设备订单增长了 77%。

订单的增加已经导致现金流量的大幅扩张。 季度自由现金流总计 51 亿美元，导致管理层将 2026 年全年自由现金流预测大幅上调至 115 亿美元至 125 亿美元之间，从之前的 65 亿美元至 75 亿美元区间上升。
